title: Specialty insurers not prohibited.
bodyText: Nothing in this article shall prevent an insurer from offering motor vehicle insurance policies for only U-drive motor vehicles.
bodyHtml: §431:10C-106  Specialty insurers not prohibited.  Nothing in this article shall prevent an insurer from offering motor vehicle insurance policies for only U-drive motor vehicles. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2; am L 1989, c 208, §2; am L 1997, c 251, §17]
